headline: Moderna (MRNA) Faces Norovirus Setback As MFLUSIVA FDA Decision Nears
summary: Moderna reported its Q2 update alongside news that its lead norovirus vaccine candidate did not meet early success criteria in a Phase 3 interim analysis, so the trial will continue for further evaluation. The company is awaiting an FDA decision on its seasonal influenza vaccine, mFLUSIVA, which is expected by early August. Management paired these pipeline updates with Q2 results that were ahead of expectations and a revised outlook for operating expenses. For investors watching...
